subject.title: fix(plugins): detect orphan diagnostics with explicit code marker (2-part fix)

question: Should legacy no-code, no-pluginId orphan diagnostics be invalidated in the runtime registry snapshot path after proof, or should that cleanup move to doctor/migration-owned repair code?
rationale: Repository policy treats persisted state and runtime fallback behavior as upgrade-sensitive, and this PR intentionally changes the upgraded runtime fast path for legacy SQLite rows.

options.title: Accept Runtime Legacy Invalidation After Proof
options.body: Require redacted latest-head proof for the pre-code SQLite row, then merge the runtime fallback as a bounded upgrade repair.

options.title: Move Legacy Cleanup To Doctor
options.body: Keep the explicit marker and schema preservation, but remove the no-code runtime branch and handle legacy rows through doctor or migration repair.

options.title: Accept Source And Test Proof
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally waive external legacy-upgrade proof and rely on source inspection plus regression tests for this compatibility-sensitive path.

recommendation.title: Accept Runtime Legacy Invalidation After Proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted latest-head proof for the pre-code SQLite row, then merge the runtime fallback as a bounded upgrade repair.

likelyOwner.reason: This person gave the predecessor's explicit-marker direction and recently touched the affected plugin registry code.
